messages:
Aisha (CS Ops): Heads up — dedupe job failed again, health scores skewing for enterprise cohort. Playbook automation might fire false renewal-risk flags. Anyone seen this?

Tom (CS Eng): On it. Saw the alert earlier. Logs show timeout on /sync endpoint and retries piling up.

Maya (CSM): We're seeing ~8 false red alerts in NA accounts list. Can we pause playbook triggers until this is sorted?

Jordan (Data Eng): I can confirm: the health_score calc divides by days_since_onboard; for a handful of enterprise rows onboarding_date was NULL so result jumped. Working on a safe guard.

OpsBot: job:crm-dedupe failed at 2026-02-15T08:12Z — reason=timeout (retry=3)

Jordan (Data Eng): Proposed quick fix (will deploy to staging):
```
UPDATE accounts
SET onboarding_days = COALESCE(DATEDIFF(day, onboarding_date, CURRENT_DATE), 999)
WHERE onboarding_date IS NULL;
```
Also adding check in health_score function: if onboarding_days > 3650 then treat as 0 days contribution.

Aisha (CS Ops): Can we backfill health scores for affected accounts and re-run playbook for those with renewal_date < 90d? Need to avoid customer noise.

Tom (CS Eng): I paused the auto-risk playbook in admin UI (/admin/playbooks/auto-risk) — disabled triggers. Restarting dedupe job now.

Jordan (Data Eng): Running backfill script: `/scripts/backfill_health.sh --since=2026-02-01 --cohort=enterprise` — will post progress. Adding unit test to cover NULL onboarding_date.

Maya (CSM): Thanks. I'll compile the list of impacted customers and draft outreach. Prefer to re-run playbook only after we confirm corrected scores.

Tom (CS Eng): Dedupe job restarted, initial pass completed — 120 accounts flagged for backfill. Playbook remains paused. I'll add a note to the postmortem doc.

Aisha (CS Ops): Follow-ups: @Jordan — complete backfill + test; @Tom — postmortem + verify job stability; @Maya — customer outreach draft. Re-enable playbook only after signoff. :thumbsup:

Maya (CSM): Will coordinate outreach. ETA for re-enable? Prefer 24h after green signal.

Jordan (Data Eng): Backfill 50% done, running final verification. Will ping when all health_scores are recalculated.

Tom (CS Eng): Added quick alert rule: if >5% of cohort health changed >0.5 in 1h, auto-pause playbooks. Should help prevent noisy triggers.

Aisha (CS Ops): Solid. Thanks everyone — keep updates in thread.
